description: ARCS, built in the open since day zero: a live product that grades itself. Proof over promises, one commit at a time.
top_line: Live build status, measured from the repository

su.title: The whole terrain at one glance… awaiting a decision, next, in progress, shipped.
su.lead: Section 05 is the short Now/Next/Later. This is the depth: every item on the debt tracker, counted live by status label, with a curated list of public items on each card.

live.hero-day, era-day, stat-days: calendar-day math from T0 2026-04-09 in the browser (ET); floor stamped at build
live.pl-commit, pl-deploy, pl-prs: /api/pulse commit, deploy, prsOpen (GitHub, server-side); no floor beyond 'loading'
live.su counts and items: /api/pulse debt.byStatus and items; floor = tracker counts at build
live.tempo-live: /api/pulse tempo; floor = git merges per week at build
live.gate counts (data-g): /api/pulse gates (database, server-side); floor = last value seen, hand-set

unsourced.14+ client surfaces (hero stat; explorer: hand-written; no catalog count matches the claim (surface-catalog.json lists ~95 aliases, not client surfaces)
unsourced.13 milestones (build explorer): hand-written; count of the MILESTONES array in explorer.js, not stamped
unsourced.milestone commit hashes (explorer.js): each names a real commit; verifiable with git, not checked at build
unsourced.CADENCE weekly commits (explorer.js, 'me: hand-pasted from git log and stale; derivable from git, not wired
unsourced.128 commits with no AI co-author, the ha: derivable from commit trailers; not wired, definition of 'fully by hand' not written down
unsourced.43-operator library (instrument panel): operators/OPERATOR-REGISTRY.json could back it; not wired
